teaser.en: A little-known tree of the coastal woodlands, listed as Vulnerable, with lopsided paired leaflets and short warty pods.
teaser.sw: Mti usiojulikana sana wa misitu ya pwani, ulioorodheshwa kuwa Hatarini, wenye vijani vya jozi visivyolingana pande na maganda mafupi yenye vidutu.

summary.en: *Chikwadzu* is a small to medium tree of evergreen and deciduous woodland near the coast. It is listed as Vulnerable by the IUCN.
summary.sw: *Chikwadzu* ni mti mdogo hadi wa wastani wa misitu isiyopukutisha majani na inayopukutisha majani karibu na pwani. Umeorodheshwa na IUCN kuwa Hatarini (Vulnerable).

about.en: *Chikwadzu* is a small to medium-sized tree of the pea family. Its leaves are made of paired leaflets that are lopsided, with one side wider than the other. Its pods are short, rounded and warty on the surface.
about.sw: *Chikwadzu* ni mti mdogo hadi wa ukubwa wa wastani wa familia ya kunde. Majani yake yanaundwa na vijani vya jozi visivyolingana pande, upande mmoja ukiwa mpana kuliko mwingine. Maganda yake ni mafupi, ya mviringo na yenye vidutu juu yake.

where.en: It grows in evergreen and deciduous woodland near the coast, from sea level to about 150 metres.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu isiyopukutisha majani na inayopukutisha majani karibu na pwani, kuanzia usawa wa bahari hadi takriban mita 150.

uses.en: No particular uses have been recorded among the Digo so far.
uses.sw: Hadi sasa hakuna matumizi maalumu yaliyorekodiwa miongoni mwa Wadigo.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chikwadzu*. No Swahili or English name has been recorded; its scientific name is *Cynometra webberi*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *chikwadzu*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; jina lake la kisayansi ni *Cynometra webberi*.

conservation.en: It is listed as Vulnerable by the IUCN.
